products.title: Cafec Abaca Cone 4 Cups 100pcs AC4-100W
products.body_html:
The Eco-Friendly Solution for Specialty Coffee Brewing

Crafted from non-wood material Manila hemp and mixed with wood pulp, the Cafec Abaca Paper Filter boasts excellent breathability, liquid permeability, and elasticity for a smooth coffee brewing experience. Thanks to its innovative 2-side crepe feature, it offers a reduced risk of blockages during brewing, preserving the aroma of your specialty coffee.

Not only is this filter paper tough and strong - it is also 4 times stronger but 2 times thinner than normal wood materials, making it a sustainable and biodegradable choice. It's even authorised by the Japan Hand-Drip Championship for the ultimate seal of approval.

Designed for use with the Cafec Flower Dripper, the Abaca Paper Filter is also compatible with other conical drippers like the Origami Dripper, Kōno Dripper, and Hario V60. Choose from options for 1-2 cups or 2-4 cups, and enjoy a guilt-free and delicious cup of coffee with the Cafec Abaca Paper Filter.

Main Features
  • Made of non-wood material Manila hemp, Abaca
  • Biodegradable and eco-friendly
  • Excellent air and water permeability
  • Soft but tough
  • JHDC (Japan Hand-Drip Championship) authorised product
  • No added fluorescent substance
  • Designed for CAFEC Flower Dripper, compatible with Origami Dripper, Kōno Dripper, Hario V60
  • For 2-4 cups

products.title: Matcha 500gr
products.body_html: Chinese Matcha, cultivated organically on the Taishan Tea Plantation located in the north-western part of the Province Zhejiang. Just like is done with high quality Gyokuros, the selected tea shrubs are kept in the shade for some time before plucking in order to increase their chlorophyll content. Compared to the Japanese production, this fair-coloured, reed-green and finely powdered Matcha offers a rather robust character with lots of volume and the authentic acerbity of typical green teas. The bowl turns moss green in colour, with a strong and fresh bouquet as well as a slight tartness in the aftertaste.

products.title: Mellow Fellow
products.body_html: Our trusty old school daily driver, this coffee has a more robust character. A creamy chocolate & nutty body with a full, lingering marzipan sweetness. This comforting daily driver will soothe your mornings with its classic profile.

products.title: Muniz
products.body_html: Discover this Anaerobic Natural Brazil from Adriano Muniz. Under a chocolate nutty body, enjoy a herbal complexity with a blueberry finish to change things up for your daily driver.

products.title: Muvna 2nd Gen Constant Pressure Tamper 58mm
products.body_html: The Muvna 2nd Gen Constant Pressure Tamper features a flat bottom design for a classic tamp with a spring-loaded assisted tamp for the same results time after time.

products.title: Muvna Adjustable Precision Tamper "Star" 58.35mm
products.body_html: The Muvna Adjustable Precision Tamper with its "star-shaped" design will make you the star of coffee. With a 58.35mm diameter, it ensures precise tamping in most conventional tampers. A click system also allows you to regulate the depth of tamping, so each tamp is consistent.

products.title: Muvna Adjustable Precision Tamper "Star" Ridged Walnut 53mm
products.body_html: The Muvna Adjustable Precision Tamper 'Star' comes in at 53mm diameter, perfect for upgrading several home machine tampers. It's adjustable for you to find the perfect tamping depth time after time, and the walnut handle offers comfort & style. The ridged tamping surface helps to disperse water more evenly.

products.title: Muvna Air Blowing Dandelion
products.body_html: The Muvna Dandelion is a compact air blower to remove loose fines on top of your prepped puck, from countertops and from your grinders. A couple of squeezes and it cleans everything up.

products.title: Muvna Anti-static Bean Spray Black 10ml
products.body_html: The Muvna Anti-static Bean Spray gets rid of you grinder and countertops getting covered in grounds and chaff. Spray one or two sprits on your weighed out coffee before you grind it and you'll have a cleaner workflow.

products.title: Muvna Countertop Brush
products.body_html: The Muvna Countertop Brush is a must need to keep your coffee station clean of chaff, ground coffee and more. The wide shape covers a big area and the magnets allow you to keep everything nice and compact together,

products.title: Muvna Dosing Cup 58mm
products.body_html: The MUVNA Dosing Cup is a sleek and functional container for catching coffee grounds and getting them all into you 58mm portafilter. This nifty item makes sure your single dosing workflow becomes buttery smooth.

products.title: Muvna Espresso Knock Box
products.body_html: The Muvna Espresso Knock Box features a reinforced knock bar and a non-slip base, this bucket offers stability and ease of use, making cleanup quick and effortless. A great pair next to your espresso machine on your coffee station.

products.title: Muvna Gravity espresso distributor Black 58,35MM
products.body_html:
This sturdy and heavy Muvna Espresso distributor ensures even grounds distribution for a perfect brew.

It's gravity driven mechanism automatically helps for a perfect distribution.

Perfect for professionals and home baristas alike.

Its low-profile and sturdy design makes it perfect for espresso machines with limited cup clearance.

products.title: Muvna Latte Pitcher
products.body_html: The Muvna Latte Pitchers are a solid upgrade from the pitchers you get with home machines. The sharp spout will make your latte arts come out crispy clean while the wide handle will support all wiggly moves.

products.title: Muvna Precision Tamper Wood + Steel 58.35mm
products.body_html: The Muvna Precision Tamper is a classic tamper that fits 58.35mm baskets/portafilters. No adjustable knick-knack, but it boasts a square design to ensure a steady grip - this tamper allows you to truly master the art of tamping.

products.title: Muvna Xingyu Espresso Cup 100mL
products.body_html: The Muvna Espresso Dosing Cup allows you to quickly and accurately measure your desired dose for espresso and milk recipes. Its low-profile and sturdy steel design makes it perfect for espresso machines with limited cup clearance.

products.title: Outdoor 6 Panel Cap
products.body_html: Stay comfortable and protected in any weather with this Outdoor 6-Panel Cap. Designed for durability, it features a wind and waterproof shell and a mesh-lining inside for breathability. The low-profile design and padded satin sweatband ensure a comfortable fit, finished with a new generation buckle for easy adjustment and taped seams for extra resilience.

products.title: Papayo My Guy-O
products.body_html: We're proud to have gotten our hands on this Papayo produced by Yury Montanchez at Finca Los Guaduales in San Agustin, Huila, Colombia. Our third time purchasing this Washed complex coffee, it brings that classic Kenya vibe with a Colombian sweetness to it. Take a moment to enjoy this clean & complex filter once again with its juicy Cassis and Pear pop, a brightness like Lemon and a lil something Floral in the end to finish it off.

products.title: Passion Pop
products.body_html: This experimental Maypop - purple passionflower & its fruit - co-infused Caturra from Finca La Milan, Quindio, Colombia produced by Julio Cesar Madrid (Cafe Uba) tastes like a fresh Maracuya chilling on the beach with some Coconuts in one hand and some delicate Rose Petals on the other. For those not afraid to go out of bounds with coffee.

products.title: Pet Nat
products.body_html: This Anaerobic Natural SL28 from Mitandi, Kibaati, Rwenzori Mountains, in Western Uganda produced by the Tuganzangane Coffee Farmers is a funky fruity fella. Get light and groovy with its Natural Wine tasting notes, sweet Red Berry Jam boy and subtle herbaceous notes of Pepper dancing in the back.

products.title: Pitcher Perfect
products.body_html:
We've always played with the idea of having a blend in our heads. Now the right time has come to offer a blend that suits a traditional palate and will punch right through milk. Hence the Pitcher Perfect. This basic full force blend of a Washed Colombia and a Natural Ethiopia with boost your milky drinks with a Dark Chocolate body, a smooth Marzipan sweetness and lingering Berry aftertaste.

Transparency note: The previous Pitcher was 50% Peru. That coffee is finished, so we replaced it with a Washed Colombia from Huila produced by the Timana Community. We have replaced it with this decaf from Brazil with a more Nutty profile.

products.title: Ruanda 500g
products.body_html: This organic black tea has a long, wiry, brownish leaf and its taste is slightly spicy with a pleasant citrus note. The brightly shining cup releases a spicy, fresh aroma.

products.title: Ruby Chocolate
products.body_html: This Natural Ethiopia from the Haro Sorsa, Western Guji, Ethiopia region is full of classic flavours! Expect a comfortable dose of Chocolate, with more adventurous flavours of Berries coming through and a Floral finish to round it out. This is the gateway pick for starting to like more fruity & fresh coffees!

products.title: Rum Cherry Rum
products.body_html: This Anaerobic Natural Ethiopia produced at the Lalesa site in the Gedeb region is full of funky fruity flavours! Expect heaps of funk from this beautiful fermentation alongside tropical fruitiness. Massive Maraschino Cherries shining their light on its boozy counterparts of Jamaican Rum with a hefty big Brownie body.

products.title: Saenz
products.body_html: This 120 hour Macerated coffee from Finca El Roble in El Salvador has a pleasant and a funky side - this friendly fella boasts Strawberry and Orange over a Creamy and Boozy undertone.

products.title: Sage Bambino
products.body_html:
Serious espresso. Serious value.

The faster way to professional results at home. Like professional machines, the Bambino can deliver third wave speciality coffee. This is made possible by the 4 keys formula. Delivering barista quality performance using a 54mm portafilter with 18 grams of coffee for full flavour and a powerful steam wand to create microfoam required for latte art. With a proprietary ThermoJet heating system the machine is ready to start in 3 seconds.

products.title: Sage Barista Pro
products.body_html: Barista quality performance with an intuitive interface that displays all the information you need to create third wave speciality coffee at home. The integrated grinder delivers the right amount of ground coffee on demand, for rich full flavour. With a ThermoJet heating system, 3 second heat up time and precise espresso extraction, you go from bean to cup faster than ever before.

products.title: Sage Dual Boiler
products.body_html: At the heart of this machine is a dual boiler heating system. The boiler, for the espresso shot, is PID temperature controlled, while a separate steam boiler offers instant and powerful steam on demand. So you can extract your shot at the right temperature, delivering optimal flavour, while simultaneously steaming your milk.

products.title: Sherpa Jacket Snake
products.body_html: The Brooker is our premium sherpa jacket, delivering style, comfort and functionality in equal measure. Inspired by retail trends, this relaxed fit unisex jacket with sherpa fabric stands out for its premium details and outstanding decoration possibilities. Made from 100% recycled polyester from post-consumer plastic bottles, the Brooker is an ideal choice for creating custom outdoor wear. It has a fully bonded inside fleece layer with an anti-pill finish for a premium look and feel over time. Strategically placed contrast softshell inserts on the chest pocket, back yoke and collar band expand the possibilities for decoration placement and techniques and give a striking look. While convenient zipped side pockets make this stylish blank sherpa jacket a highly practical garment that's perfect for any kind of outdoor activities.

products.title: Shopper Croc
products.body_html: The Shopping Bag 2.0 is the latest version of our blank woven shopping bag designed for daily use. Featuring a folded hem at the top edge and a hidden snap closure, this bag combines durability and functionality. The bottom and side gussets add extra space, perfect for carrying all your essentials. This bag can be carried by hand or over the shoulder thanks to the both long and short self-fabric handles reinforced with cross-stitching, making it as versatile as it gets. Inside, a self-fabric pocket provides convenient storage for smaller items, while the herringbone tape on the inside seams gives this shopper a clean, polished finish. The single needle stitch at the top edge adds to its durability. This customisable tote bag provides a great surface for printing or embroidery, making it a great option for branding or merchandising. As a reusable shopping bag, it’s practical and eco-friendly, ideal for brands prioritising sustainability.

products.title: Sleep Well DECAF
products.body_html:
You'll certainly have sweet dream with this CO2 decaffeinated pleasant fella from Pinhalão, Parana in Brazil. Produced by Dulces Sueños, this decaf will comfort your decaf espresso cravings. Big old school flavours, enjoy this sweet treat with its Nutty body, smooth Milk Chocolate sweetness and creaminess like Marzipan. You'll be surprising guests left, right and center making them go "that's decaf?!" 

Transparency note: The previous Sleep Well from Honduras is finished. We have replaced it with this decaf from Brazil with a more Nutty profile. Expect less fruitiness and toffee and more Nuts, creaminess and a smooth Chocolate body. Perfect for milk, decaf coffee cocktails or just as is. It is also now a CO2 decaffeinated coffee, not the H2O decaffeination process.

products.title: The Fermentation Project
products.body_html: We are thrilled to take part in The Fermentation Project, an effort organized by James Hoffmann and Lucia Solis to explore the effects of four different controlled fermentation methods listed below. Each process was performed on the same lot of coffee, to truly highlight the nuances of each processing method and remove all other variables. Tune in to the global tasting event led by James Hoffman on October 3rd Live on YouTube. Coffees will be roasted on the 11th of September to allow for at least 3 weeks of resting prior to the tasting.

products.title: The Forager
products.body_html: This Washed Ethiopia from the Halo Beriti Washing Station in Gedeb, Yirgacheffe punches through like a Natural with the delicacy of a Washed. Either start foraging for Forest Fruits to make a lovely homemade jam or just enjoy those flavours in this cup with added Chocolate body and Caramel sweetness.

products.title: Thousand Hills
products.body_html: This is our 4th year getting Valentin Kimenyi's coffee, who shares the colourful flavours from Rwanda with his Gasharu Coffee Ireme Anaerobic Natural Red Bourbon from Nyamasheke. This year, the coffee takes a slightly more gentle approach with a soothing Cacao Nibs body layered with a Peach sweetness and a subtle yet present Boozy baddie finish.
